name: VLEAPP
description: Vehicle Logs, Events and Properties Parser
report_description: VLEAPP is an open source project that aims to parse vehicle data for the purpose of triage analysis and validation.
objective: Triage Vehicle Infotainment and Telematics Extractions.
source_hint: A tar, zip or gz archive, a Berla iVe .iVa export, a disk image (raw image, E01, AFF, DMG or virtual disk, L01 or AD1), or a folder holding files extracted from a vehicle's infotainment or telematics unit. Several disk images of a RAID set can be picked together.
